messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — want a short async sync on the private deploy roadmap canvas. Focus: packaging profiles, upgrade lanes, and customer-managed networking. Who's free?
jasper: I can do a quick run. Can we limit to decisions we need before next customer workshop?
elaine: Yep. Need answers on: minimal installer presets, expected downtime for patch upgrades, and netops handoff points.
maria: Bringing the field asks: customers want an installer 'thin' profile + an ops profile. Thin = no relay, customer NAT only. Ops = relay + support bundle.
frank: Also: upgrade story. Customers asked for in-place patch without rebootstrap. We need to confirm whether our operator supports zero-drift upgrades for the operator + host networking changes.
jasper: Current plan: semantic upgrades (operator CRD-aware) for minor patches, full bundle swap for major schema changes. Downtime estimate: minor ~30s per node (rolling), major ~ maintenance window. Need to validate SLA language.
netops: Quick note — customer-managed networking scenarios fall into 3 tiers: fully-managed (our relay), constrained (NAT + outbound only), and on-prem airgapped. Each has different IP/ASN expectations.
elaine: Good. For the roadmap, propose we ship: Q3 alpha = thin installer + relay-op toggle; Q4 = in-place minor upgrades (canary+rollback); Q1 next = major zero-drift upgrade path. Thoughts?
maria: Sounds reasonable. Field asks: expose a toggle for customer to opt-out of our relay and provide public egress IPs list for allowlisting.
frank: We should provide an installer snippet for the thin profile. Example:
```
installer.profile: thin
network.mode: customer-nat
egress.allowlist: ["<customer-egress-ip>"]
operator.upgrade.strategy: rolling
```
jasper: +1. Also add a brief preflight that checks IPAM and DNS. Failure should block install with clear remediation.
netops: Agree. Preflight should test: outbound endpoints, TLS handshake with control-plane, and port 443 egress to relay (if used). Provide tooling doc for NetOps to hand to customers.
maria: For upgrade paths, customers want an explicit revert token and a staged canary. We should define canary size (5% tenants or 1 node) and automatic revert on error rate spike.
frank: Implementation detail: runtime keeps KV cache compatibility for minor versions only. Major requires KV migration and explicit operator runbook. We'll note that in launch criteria.
elaine: Launch criteria proposal (short): 1) thin + ops profiles implemented; 2) preflight checks + docs; 3) minor in-place upgrade validated in staging with canary rollback; 4) network toggle + egress allowlist doc; 5) runbook for major upgrade.
jasper: Timeline acceptance: can do Q3 alpha for 1,2,4 as experimental; Q4 for 3; Q1 for 5. Need sign-off from legal/security for allowlist docs.
maria: I'll gather field customers for alpha. Ask: do we expose installer UX in Console or CLI first?
frank: CLI first — faster. Console follow-up in Q4.
elaine: Action items: @jasper draft installer templates and preflight checks (due in 1w); @frank draft upgrade runbook for majors/minors (2w); @maria recruit 3 pilot customers (2w); @netops draft internal NetOps checklist (1w).
deploy-bot: Reminder — created ticket RDW-privdeploy-202 in Jira for "Deploy Canvas: thin/op profiles + preflight".
elaine: Thanks — will update the roadmap doc and ping legal for allowlist wording. If anyone has hard blockers, flag here. :thumbsup:
jasper: No blockers from infra. Will post PR with templates by EOD Fri.
maria: Field ok with CLI-first. Will schedule pilots next week.
frank: I'll prototype the rollback token flow and share a short runbook snippet.
elaine: Great, closing the async sync. We'll surface results in next product review. :rocket:
